voiceName: Dorien (phone, garden, no denoise), the clone used for Rooted, Don Tuco and Lucienne. Never de-ess it.

lines.n_stats: Seventy-six percent of shoppers prefer to buy in their own language. Translation fixes the words. It doesn't fix the references.
lines.n_copy: So here's the demo copy: chocolate from Bocas del Toro, with very European hooks. And three rooms to win. Tokyo, Brussels, and Austin.
lines.n_run: One click. The agent asks Qloo what each room actually loves: artists, films, books, brands and places, filtered by city and age.
lines.n_log: This is a live run, not a mockup. Every reference gets tested against Qloo's taste data, and every replacement must come from what Qloo returned in this very run. The agent cannot invent a reference. Grounded, or rejected.
lines.n_verdict: The verdict: three rewrites, each with its taste facts. The exact Qloo entities, and their affinity scores, behind every swap.
lines.n_brussels: And Brussels? In the saved run from October twenty-fifth, it dropped the praline line outright. Comparing this chocolate to the city's own praline invites a contest with local chocolate. A call no translation tool would make.
lines.n_honest: And when Qloo has no data, like Port wine, or a Willemstad audience, my agent says so. Flagged, never faked.
lines.n_outro: Lengua Fina. Every reference, traceable to Qloo. Built for the Qloo Agentic Hackathon.
